home.title: Your moments, handled with care.
home.intro: How to use BestShot, and how your photos, videos, and data are handled.

sections.title: From a short video to three favorites
paragraphs: BestShot is an iPhone app that picks three photos from a short video to match the moment you want to capture. Your original video and selected photos are saved in the app’s library.

sections.title: You choose when images are sent
paragraphs: Online AI selection sends up to 12 reduced-size candidate images and your selection instructions after you agree on the confirmation screen. On-device mode selects by brightness and sharpness without sending images.

sections.title: Current availability
paragraphs: BestShot is currently a TestFlight beta. Online AI selection requires the test access code provided with an invitation. The current version has no in-app purchases or subscriptions.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Where your data goes, how it is stored, and your choices.
privacy.intro: The information BestShot handles, why it is used, and how to request deletion.

sections.title: Operator and scope
paragraphs: sunagaku, the developer and operator of BestShot, provides this policy for information handled by the BestShot iOS app, its online selection service, and this website. Contact us at the email address below.

sections.title: Information on your device
items: Recorded or imported videos, extracted photos, selection instructions and results, names, and library history are stored in the app’s device storage. Recorded videos may contain audio if you allow microphone access.
The test access code is stored in the device Keychain; preferences such as selection mode are stored locally.
Photos are exported to Photos or shared with other apps when you choose those actions. Device data may be included in Apple backups depending on your iOS and backup settings.

sections.title: Information sent for online AI selection
paragraphs: After you agree on the confirmation screen, up to 12 reduced-size JPEG candidate images, selection instructions including free text, frame IDs, elapsed positions within the video, and on-device quality scores are sent through the BestShot server to OpenAI. The complete original video, its audio, and full-resolution extracted photos are not sent for AI selection.

Images may contain faces, backgrounds, and visible text. Ensure you have the rights and any required permission from the people shown or their guardians before recording or sending them. Avoid including sensitive information in images or instructions.

On-device mode does not send images or instructions to BestShot servers or OpenAI for selection. It compares brightness and sharpness and does not interpret expressions or the meaning of your instructions.

sections.title: Server records and purposes
paragraphs: The BestShot database stores a selection ID, instructions, processing provider and model, candidate count, selected frame IDs, ranks, scores, reasons, and creation time. Request IDs and time information are also stored to enforce usage limits. These records support selection, operation checks, troubleshooting, and prevention of abuse and excessive use.

Candidate images, original videos, and access codes are not stored in this database. Images are handled temporarily during transmission and processing. Normal application logging does not print request bodies or OpenAI error bodies.

The current version has no user account registration and does not request your name or email address or collect advertising identifiers. It does not provide face recognition to identify people or infer sensitive personal attributes. We do not sell information or track you for advertising.

sections.title: Service providers and international processing
items: OpenAI processes candidate images and instructions to return selection results. We send store: false to the Responses API; this does not disable all retention. Abuse monitoring, image safety checks, and other exceptions follow [OpenAI’s API data controls](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data) and applicable service settings.

Cloudflare provides API networking, execution, and database infrastructure. Connection information such as IP addresses may be processed for infrastructure operation and security. See [Cloudflare’s privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

GitHub Pages hosts this website. GitHub records visitor IP addresses for security. We do not add advertising, analytics scripts, or cookie-based tracking to this site. See the [GitHub privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
Apple provides TestFlight distribution, feedback you submit, Photos, and device backup services. Its handling is subject to [Apple’s privacy policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).

Support emails include your reply address and the content you provide; we use them to respond and verify requests as needed. These providers and email infrastructure may process information outside Japan or your country of residence, subject to their safeguards and applicable law.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Local history, photos, and videos remain until you delete them. Copies exported to Photos or shared elsewhere must be managed separately. Backup retention and restoration follow the relevant service settings.

The current beta has no automatic deletion deadline for server selection metadata or usage-limit records. They remain until the operator deletes them or fulfills an identifiable deletion request. Deleting local history or uninstalling the app does not delete server records.

Providers such as OpenAI, backups, and security records have their own retention policies and legal requirements. Immediate erasure of every copy is not guaranteed. Support correspondence is retained for handling requests and necessary recordkeeping; you may request deletion of information no longer needed.

sections.title: Withdrawal, deletion, and your rights
paragraphs: To stop future AI transfers, cancel before sending or switch off the AI photo-selection option in settings. Camera, microphone, and photo permissions can be changed in iOS settings. Withdrawal does not affect lawful processing already completed.

Delete a recording from its menu in the app library. See [Delete your data](https://sean-sunagaku.github.io/bestshot-legal/en/delete-data/) for server deletion requests. The current version has no user accounts and therefore no account-deletion process.

Email us about access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, or receipt and transfer of your data where applicable law grants these rights. We will check applicable conditions and verify the requester and relevant records. You may also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Minors, security, and changes
paragraphs: Minors should obtain parental or guardian permission where required by law. BestShot is not offered as a service directed at children. Contact us if you have concerns about a child’s information.
Safeguards include encrypted transport, access-code protection for the API, and no public shared-history API. Take care when sharing a device, exporting photos, or sending them to other services.

We update this page when features or data practices change. Material changes will be announced in the app or on this site, and we will seek consent in advance where a new processing activity requires it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: Conditions of use, image rights, and AI selection.
terms.intro: Please review these conditions together with the privacy policy before using BestShot.

sections.title: Scope and service
paragraphs: These terms apply to the BestShot app and online selection service provided by sunagaku (the operator). Review them before using the service. Minors must obtain guardian permission where applicable law requires it.
BestShot helps select photos from videos through on-device quality analysis or online AI selection with your consent. Review the results yourself before saving or sharing them.

sections.title: Your photos and videos
paragraphs: Rights in your videos, photos, and other content remain with you or their respective rights holders. The operator handles submitted candidate images and instructions only as needed to provide the service.

You must have the rights and permissions needed to record, import, send for AI processing, save, and share content. Do not infringe anyone’s image rights, privacy, copyright, or confidentiality, or use illegal content such as nonconsensual intimate imagery or child sexual exploitation material.

sections.title: Prohibited use and access codes
items: Do not use the service unlawfully, harass others, infringe rights, gain unauthorized access, or attack the service or third parties.
Do not bypass technical or usage limits or disrupt operation with excessive automated requests.
Keep test access codes secure and do not publish or redistribute them. Contact the operator if you suspect a leak.
Do not use photo rankings for identity verification or consequential decisions about a person’s health, sensitive attributes, employment, or similar matters.

sections.title: AI and external services
paragraphs: AI ranks, scores, and reasons are suggestions. Accuracy, alignment with your preferences, and any particular outcome are not guaranteed. On-device mode evaluates brightness and sharpness rather than expressions or the meaning of free-text instructions.

Online selection uses Cloudflare and OpenAI. Network conditions, provider restrictions, safety decisions, or usage limits may cause failure or delay. See the [privacy policy](https://sean-sunagaku.github.io/bestshot-legal/en/privacy/) for recipients and retention.

sections.title: Beta availability and charges
paragraphs: The current service is a TestFlight beta. Online AI selection requires an invitation access code and is subject to usage limits. Beta software may have bugs, feature changes, distribution expiration, or service termination. Keep your own copies of important photos and videos.

The current version has no in-app purchases or auto-renewing subscriptions. If paid features are introduced, their scope, price, period, renewal, and cancellation terms will be shown before purchase. Publishing these terms does not create a purchase or subscription.

sections.title: License and Apple terms
paragraphs: Rights in the app, including copyright and trademarks, belong to the operator or the relevant rights holders. You may use the app under applicable conditions.

Unless a separate custom EULA is presented, the license for an app distributed through Apple is governed by [Apple’s standard EULA](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/). These terms supplement the service conditions. Apple terms or applicable law prevail where required. Apple’s testing-service terms also apply to TestFlight.

sections.title: Changes, suspension, and liability
paragraphs: Features or access may be changed, limited, or suspended for maintenance, faults, safety, or abuse prevention. We will give advance notice where possible, or notice promptly afterward if advance notice is impractical.

To the extent permitted by law, the operator does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service or suitability for a particular purpose. Data preservation has limitations. These terms do not exclude liability for intentional misconduct or gross negligence, or any liability or consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.

sections.title: Updates, governing law, and contact
paragraphs: We revise this page and its date when terms change. Material changes will be announced in the app or on this site, with notice or consent procedures required by law.
These terms use Japanese law as their reference without excluding mandatory consumer protections or access to courts in your place of residence. Contact us first if you encounter a problem.

support.title: Support
support.summary: Using the app, common questions, and contacting us.
support.intro: Get help with BestShot, report an issue, or share feedback.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Operator: sunagaku, BestShot developer. Contact us with bugs, questions, feature requests, or privacy concerns. You can also use Send Beta Feedback in TestFlight.

For an issue, include the app version and build, iOS version, steps, displayed error, and approximate occurrence time with time zone. You do not need to send access codes, API keys, personal photos, or videos.

sections.title: Record or import a video
paragraphs: Record a five-second video or choose a video of up to 30 seconds from Photos. Choose the kind of moment you want or enter your own selection instructions.
Check BestShot permissions in iPhone Settings if you have trouble with the camera, microphone, or saving to Photos. Recording without audio is available if microphone access is denied.

sections.title: AI selection and connection errors
paragraphs: Online AI selection needs an internet connection and the test access code provided with your invitation. You do not need an OpenAI API key. Candidate images are sent after you agree on the confirmation screen.
For an access-code error, check your invitation instructions. For usage-limit or timeout errors, wait and retry. Beta usage limits may change with service operation.
To avoid sending images, choose the option to select on the device without sending, or turn off AI photo selection in settings. On-device results are based on brightness and sharpness.

sections.title: Save, share, or delete
paragraphs: Your three selected photos and original video are saved in the app library. From the results screen, you can export to Photos or use iOS sharing.

Use Delete in a recording’s library menu to remove its three photos and original video from the app. Copies in Photos or other services remain. See [Delete your data](https://sean-sunagaku.github.io/bestshot-legal/en/delete-data/).

sections.title: Charges and languages
paragraphs: The current beta has no in-app purchases or subscriptions.

This website is available in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. The current app interface and AI selection explanations are in Japanese. Changing the website language does not change the app language.

delete-data.title: Delete your data
delete-data.summary: Remove local media or request deletion of server records.
delete-data.intro: Local photos and videos and online selection records require different deletion steps.

sections.title: Photos and videos on your device
items: Open the BestShot library and choose Delete from the recording’s menu. Confirm to remove that recording’s three photos and original video from the app.
Delete exported copies separately in Photos. Check Recently Deleted, iCloud Photos, and device backup settings. Shared copies must also be handled at their destination.
Stop future online AI transfers by canceling before sending or turning off AI photo selection in settings. Uninstalling the app does not delete server records.

sections.title: Request server deletion
paragraphs: Email us below with the subject BestShot data deletion request. Include the approximate time and time zone of the online selection and only the minimum additional information you can share to identify it. A selection ID is helpful if available, but is not displayed in the app and is not required.

The current version has no user accounts. We may need additional checks to distinguish records, and may be unable to identify a unique record with insufficient information. We verify requests to avoid deleting someone else’s data, respond under applicable law, and explain the result or any limitation.
Do not send access codes, OpenAI API keys, original videos, face photos, or identity documents.

sections.title: Scope and limits
paragraphs: The BestShot server stores selection metadata such as instructions and results, and usage-limit records; it does not store candidate images or videos in its database. We accept deletion requests for identifiable selection metadata. Usage-limit records are not linked to user accounts and may not be attributable to an individual user.

OpenAI, Cloudflare, email providers, Apple, and shared destinations have their own retention, backup, and legal requirements. We will explain legal or security retention needs and technical limits on immediate deletion where relevant. See the [privacy policy](https://sean-sunagaku.github.io/bestshot-legal/en/privacy/) for details.
